gate.INDETERMINATE: Neither YES nor NO criterion holds, native evidence is unavailable, or authority/replay fails.
gate.NO: Absolute B-versus-D Cliff's delta is below 0.147 (conventional negligible effect) and unique-maximum alignment is no greater than 50%.
gate.YES: At least one fixed candidate-only criterion holds: absolute B-versus-D Cliff's delta is at least 0.474 (conventional large effect), or the frozen selected candidate is the unique native-strength maximum in at least 75% of processed multi-candidate cells.

detector.preprocessing: unchanged AudioPreprocessor stereo mean followed by peak normalization

native_evidence_captured: onset timestamp and hexadecimal float representation
native onset-envelope value at the detected frame and hexadecimal float representation
